'''Merratt Jaxton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] who served in the [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command]] and the [[Chief of Starfighter Command (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of Starfighter Command]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Apparently loyal to [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] as the tensions between the Galactic Alliance and [[New Jedi Order]] escalated, and he was the one who recommended the prosecution of [[Cha Niathal]]. However Jaxton soon became involved in a [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspiracy]] to remove Daala and restore the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and partly through these actions he became a member of the governing [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] that replaced Daala.

==Biography==
Merrat Jaxton was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|Armed Forces]]. He achieved the rank of [[Chief of Starfighter Command (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of Starfighter Command]] during the years after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] when many previous high-ranking [[Officer/Legends|officers]] had to be replaced. He was close to [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] and informed her that certain members of the Officer Corps were unhappy with the way she was handling the tensions between the government and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. It was his recommendation that she institute an impartial prosecution of [[Cha Niathal]] for dereliction of duty during [[Darth Caedus]]' rise to power during the Second Galactic Civil War, in order to appease the displeased [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and to show to the public that government officials were not spared the same prosecution that led to the [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|conviction]] of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], since both made the same mistake of trusting Caedus.

Unknown to Daala, Jaxton [[Lecersen Conspiracy|conspired]] with [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] to overthrow Daala's administration and [[High Moff]] [[Jagged Fel]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The end plot was to reinstate the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by gradually combining the Alliance and Remnant to create a new government. Once the new Empire became a reality, Lecersen and Treen intended to rule the reinstated [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and Empress. Jaxton met with Lecersen, Treen and Senator [[Fost Bramsin]] to discuss the number of naval officers that would join their cause. This led to them discussing the senior naval officer, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]], and the likelihood of his willingness to participate in the overthrow of the Chief of State. However, his loyalty to Daala made him incorruptible and, while Lecersen wanted to use subtle means to corrupt Bwua'tu, Jaxton proposed to simply assassinate him.

Jaxton was one of the people who were held hostage aboard the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' during the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournament. He was upset due to his loss to [[Wynn Dorvan]]. After returning to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he was debriefed personally by Daala. Afterward, he met with his fellow conspirators at a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Flight simulator/Legends|Holosimulator]], where they discussed their further plans.

After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] staged a [[Plan Delta|coup d'état]] against Daala's regime, just as the conspirators were about to launch their own coup, Treen negotiated with [[Grand Master/Legends|Acting Grand Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] to form a coalition government so as to gain support from all branches of the government and military while keeping their plans for a new Galactic Empire on track. The [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] agreed to the measure and the [[office of the Chief of State]] was suspended and replaced by a [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] for an indefinite period of time. The first triumvirs were composed of of Sebatyne, to represent the Jedi; Treen, for the Senate; and Jaxton, for the military.

Sometime later, Jaxton was removed from his position as triumvir and was replaced by Wynn Dorvan, a former [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] under the Daala Administration and later the first Triumvirate. When the conspiracy ultimately collapsed due to infiltration by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], Jaxton became a loose end who endangered the conspirators with his intimate knowledge of the plot to recreate the first Galactic Empire. As a consequence, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], a fellow conspirator, forced Jaxton to commit [[Death/Legends|suicide]].

==Personality and traits==
Jaxton was a Human male of average height with a squarish build that the public expected for a military leader. He was considered handsome by Senator Treen but also flighty as well. He was a skilled marksman, with the ability to fire a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] from his hip and still hit a target fifty meters away with great accuracy.
